name: opencode2-vscode-gui
description: Independent VS Code sidebar GUI for the OpenCode coding agent — slash commands, skills, forms, worktrees, undo/redo, themes. Not affiliated with the OpenCode team.

opencode2.ui.sounds.description: Play a subtle chime when the agent finishes or asks for permission.

opencode2.ui.showReasoning.description: How to display model reasoning blocks.

opencode2.ui.expandShellTools.description: Expand shell/command tool cards by default.

opencode2.ui.expandEditTools.description: Expand edit/diff tool cards by default.

opencode2.ui.fullShellOutput.description: Show full shell output without truncation (4000 char limit). When disabled, long output is truncated.

opencode2.ui.messageStats.description: Show per-message token and cost badges under assistant replies.

opencode2.composer.sendKey.description: Which key combination sends the prompt.

opencode2.models.hidden.description: Models hidden from the picker, as 'providerID/modelID' keys.

opencode2.models.favorites.description: Starred models pinned to the top of the picker, as 'providerID/modelID' keys.

opencode2.models.default.description: Default model for new sessions, as 'providerID/modelID'. Empty = server default. The built-in default is OpenCode Zen's free Big Pickle so new sessions always carry a working model binding; if it leaves the catalog, the first available free Zen model is used instead.

opencode2.notifications.errors.description: Notify when an agent run fails.

opencode2.server.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Explicit OpenCode V2 server URL (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:4096`). Leave empty to use `server.mode`.

enumDescriptions: Start our own hidden background service (default — no external CLI process needed)
opencode2.server.mode.description: How to connect to the OpenCode service.

opencode2.server.autoStart.description: Start the shared OpenCode background service when no healthy service is discovered.

opencode2.cliPath.description: Path or command name for the OpenCode CLI. Empty = try 'opencode2' then 'opencode'.

opencode2.debug.logs.description: Stream service/client diagnostics into the OpenCode 2 output channel.

opencode2.ui.theme.description: Color theme of the sidebar. Uses the built-in OpenCode 2 themes and presets, not the VS Code theme.

opencode2.ui.accentTint.description: Optional CSS color tinting live-state accents. Empty = follow the VS Code theme.

opencode2.agent.autoCompactThreshold.markdownDescription: Auto-compact a session when context usage reaches this percent. `0` disables.

opencode2.sessions.autoTitle.markdownDescription: Auto-generate a short, descriptive title for a session after its first completed turn (`session.generate`, then rename). Off by default because it spends provider tokens. A manual rename is never overridden.

opencode2.notifications.permissions.description: Notify when a session requests a permission.

enumDescriptions: Ask first — prompt for approval (default, shows banner with Allow once / Always allow / Reject)
Auto allow — automatically approve permissions that are not explicitly denied
opencode2.permissions.mode.markdownDescription: How to handle permission requests, using OpenCode's own permission semantics. **Ask first** prompts for approval (default). **Auto allow** auto-approves each request with *Allow once* — the same behaviour as OpenCode's session auto-accept (CLI `--auto`); explicit `deny` rules in your `permissions` config still win. **Deny** auto-rejects requests that would otherwise ask. `question` requests always prompt. Saved *Allow forever* rules are only created via the button on each prompt, never automatically.
